periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axes of the high-contrast black eye patches are angled approximately 45 degrees downward toward the nasal midline relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Ovoid geometry with a vertical elongation; length is approximately 1.5 times the width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Notable downward tapering toward the inner lower corner of each patch.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High relative thickness; dark band occupies approximately one-third of the visible torso height.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral spacing between ears, roughly equivalent to the width of the frontal cranial region.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: High smoothness; ears exhibit a rounded, semicircular apex curvature.
